name: Frog's Eye Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cook pasta in a large saucepan. Drain and rinse pasta.
Drain cans of pineapple and oranges, reserving juice.
Mix juices, sugar and egg yolks in a medium saucepan. Bring to full rolling boil, stirring frequently until thickened.
Pour hot sauce over pasta. Cool and refrigerate overnight.
Add fruit and mix well, then fold in whipped topping and marshmallows.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
